feedback_loop: Legacy reproduction -> exact/invariant/refinement diagnostics -> assembly or policy revision -> rerun -> coupled tables/claims. Report scaffold is not counted as scientific difficulty.

hidden_families.impurity: Interacting impurity with gapless noninteracting leads; conserved N and Sz; 14 electronic sites.
hidden_families.ladder: Doped frustrated ladder with density interactions; different graph and entanglement structure.
hidden_families.spin_orbit: Complex flux ring and spin-mixing hopping; Sz is not conserved.
hidden_families.paired: Number-nonconserving interacting superconducting wire, including nonlocal same-spin pairs; parity sector only.
hidden_families.vibronic: Dynamical truncated bosons coupled to an interacting electronic contact; mixed local Hilbert spaces.

oracle_audit: No main public target trajectories. One tiny exact dimer calibration. Public diagnostics test invariants and finite-grid continuity, not exact values. The full engine API is available but no complete general-contact solution is supplied.
shortcut_risks: A careful frontier agent may solve this by competent API integration; if empirical core score reaches 0.90, reject without adding edge cases.
Direct exact solvers are legitimate for small regimes, but full enumeration is not an efficient common solution for the largest impurity, paired and vibronic cases.

One generic propagation routine is not sufficient without correct model assembly, state sector, operator measurements, numerical controls and verification. Whether these integration demands actually defeat a frontier agent remains unproven before screening.
evaluation: Behavioral trajectory and initial-energy errors, mean plus minimum-family quality, measured time/memory, and independently rerun evidence. Core score excludes reporting completeness. Sandbox exposes only submission, assets, one input case and one writable run directory.
time_limit_audit: A deadline or a correct scalable method missing only reporting cannot establish hardness. Inspect the full transcript and partial code after screening.
paper_visibility: No target paper or target trajectories in the public mount; the unavoidable output-directory name is user-specified.
